newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos 2nd qtr sales revenue up 4 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos 2nd qtr sales revenue up 4 pct.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Monday its sales revenue for the second quarter ending June 30, 1997 rose 4.0 percent to A$194.9 million.
Sales volume compared with the previous corresponding quarter rose 6.0 percent to 10.6 million barrels of oil equivalent (boe) and production rose 4.5 percent to 10.3 million boe.

Santos said for the first half, sales revenue was up 12.2 percent to A$376.2 million, sales volume was up 10.0 percent to 19.8 million boe and production volume was up 5.6 percent to 19.9 million boe.
The company said it achieved a 64 percent success rate from exploration and appraisal wells spudded during the second quarter, in line with the frist quarter.
Santos, which is boosting its exploration programme, said it spent A$51.9 million on exploration in the second quarter, up 82 percent.
Development expenditure rose 54 percent to A$108.2 million.
The overall production rise for the quarter included a 9.5 percent increase in gas production to 42.8 petajoules, and an 11.1 percent rise in naptha/condensate production.
Santos said its acquisition of WMC Ltd's 30 percent interest in the East Spar field offshore Western Australia contributed 0.9 petajoules of gas and 58,600 barrels of condensate.

Crude oil production fell 9.7 percent in the second quarter to 1.94 million barrels, due mainly to a 46.4 percent fall in production from Timor Sea, including the end of production from the Skua field.
